pick.name: QuickBooks Online
pick.why: The default for US accountants and bookkeepers; widest integrations
pick.free_limits: Free plan: 1 user, 2 invoices/mo, 1 bank connection, 3 reports, no accountant access, no app/integrations. Paid list: Simple Start $38/mo, Essentials $85, Plus $140, Advanced $340 (US; 50% off first 3 months)

best_free.name: Zoho Books Free
best_free.free_limits: Free while FY revenue <= $50K (US page); 1,000 invoices/yr; 1 user + 1 accountant; Standard $15-20/mo

alts.name: Xero
alts.why: Strongest outside the US and for multi-currency (Established plan)
alts.free_limits: Early $27/mo (20 invoices), Growing $59, Established $97; US intro 90% off for 6 months until 2026-11-02

alts.name: Invoice Ninja
alts.what: Invoicing with multi-currency, client portal, recurring
alts.why: Invoicing-only tool with multi-currency, client portal and recurring invoices; self-hostable
alts.free_limits: Hosted free: up to 5 clients (some reviews say 20), unlimited invoices; Pro $14/mo; self-host under Elastic License 2.0 (own use OK, no hosted resale)

candidates.name: Mercury Books
candidates.verdict: $35/mo, waived until 2026-12-31 per Mercury page; new

decision: QuickBooks Online is the best overall for US-based founders because accountants already use it; Xero is better for UK/EU and multi-currency. Zoho Books Free is the best free option until revenue passes the plan cap. When a merchant of record bills customers, you only invoice B2B services and book MoR payouts.

region_notes.US: QuickBooks dominates; ask your accountant which they prefer.
region_notes.UK: Xero is the more common default with UK accountants; both Xero and QuickBooks support Making Tax Digital for VAT. Confirm with your adviser.
region_notes.India: Zoho Books includes GST returns (free cap Rs25 lakh) and TallyPrime is widely used; export invoices under LUT need specific wording (verify with a CA).
region_notes.EU: Xero or a local package your accountant uses; check local e-invoicing mandates (e.g. Germany, France, Italy) before choosing.

verify.note: QuickBooks vs Xero stress-tested: QBO list Simple Start $38, Essentials $85, Plus $140, Advanced $340 (50% off 3 months); Free plan is very thin (1 user, 2 invoices/mo, 1 bank, no accountant access, no integrations). Xero Early $27 (20 invoices), Growing $59, Established $97 (multi-currency only on Established). QBO stays best overall for US entities; Xero is the better default in UK/AU/NZ and when multi-currency matters. Add the Free plan limits.
